tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: The three courses with price per person and what is included. Prices include tax and service charge.

tools.name: recommend_course
tools.description: Suggest a course from the budget per person and whether the guest wants sake. Returns the suggestion with a reason, plus the other courses.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Link to the restaurant's TableCheck booking page with the course, date and party size already selected. The guest picks a time there, agrees to the restaurant's notice, enters their name and contact, and confirms. This tool never books, never takes payment and does not know which times are free. Ref

tools.name: get_restaurant_info
tools.description: The restaurant's own answer (from its FAQ) about one topic: price, reservation, duration, seating, tea_room, allergies, english, payment or location. Opening hours, lunch and days off are not answered here: point the guest to the booking page.
